title: FDP conversion
examples: How do I change a fraction to a percentage?
What is the easiest way to remember the connections?
Can I convert a decimal to a fraction easily?

explain.say: Today we learn three ways to show parts of a whole. We use fractions, decimals, and percentages.
A fraction shows parts using a top number and a bottom number. For example, one half is written as one over two.
A decimal uses a point to separate whole numbers from parts. One half is the same as zero point five.
A percentage means out of one hundred. So, one half is equal to fifty percent.
Let us try another one. Three quarters is the fraction. It is zero point seventy-five as a decimal. And it is seventy-five percent.

faq.q: How do I change a fraction to a decimal?
faq.a: You divide the top number by the bottom number. For example, two over five means two divided by five, which is zero point four.
asks: How do I find the decimal value?

faq.q: What is the easiest way to change a decimal to a percentage?
faq.a: You just move the decimal point two places to the right. So, zero point eight becomes eighty percent.
asks: Do I multiply by one hundred?
How do I get the percent sign?

faq.q: If I have a percentage, how do I get the fraction?
faq.a: You write the number over one hundred and then simplify the fraction. For example, twenty percent is twenty over one hundred, which simplifies to one over five.
asks: What is the fraction for 30 percent?
How do I simplify the fraction?

faq.q: Does the whole thing always add up to one?
faq.a: Yes, when you convert between these three forms, they always represent the same amount. They are all equivalent.

faq.q: What if the fraction is not easy to divide?
faq.a: You can use multiplication to find an equivalent fraction that is easier to divide. For example, to convert one third, you can use three over nine.
asks: What if I get a repeating decimal?
Can I use a different number?

facts: A fraction represents a part of a whole.
A decimal uses a point to show decimal places.
A percentage means 'out of one hundred'.
To convert a fraction to a percentage, you multiply by one hundred percent.

quiz.say: What is three tenths as a percentage?
quiz.why: You move the decimal point two places to the right, making it thirty percent.

wrong.0: This mistake forgets to add the percent sign, even though it is a percentage.
wrong.1: This is still a fraction, but the question asked for the percentage form.
wrong.3: This mistake happens because you only moved the decimal point one place to the right.

quiz.say: What is one quarter as a decimal?
quiz.why: One divided by four equals zero point two five.

wrong.0: This mistake happens if you incorrectly divide one by four.
wrong.1: This mistake only accounts for the first digit of the division.
wrong.2: This is the original fraction and not the decimal form.

quiz.say: Which of these is equivalent to two fifths?
quiz.why: Two divided by five is zero point four, which is forty percent.

wrong.0: This mistake is common when confusing two fifths with two quarters.
wrong.1: This mistake forgets that the decimal form must be equivalent to the percentage.
wrong.2: This mistake is close, but two fifths is not the same as one half.
